book.name: Maliki
book.title: N'halo ghwa maha handa paghutyekwite na MALIKI

content: Yesu kangukonywa ya kya kutolana na kulekana
Yesu kakiyomboka lukemba lwa Yoludani na kakighenda ku nnma ghwa Yudea. Lumati lwa bhandu lukintughila, naywo kakibhahunda handa kitohe kyake.
Hino Akaafalisayo bhakinng'endela kunng'eha na bhakinkonya, “Bhuli, malaghilo ghanguyegheka mundu nnume kunleka nndala ghwake?”
Yesu kakiayanga, “Musa kakiakwilikiha niki?”
Bhombe bhakinnyanga, “Musa kakitegheka kukita mundu katantyekela lihamba lya kunleka nndala ghwake na kunleka.”
Yesu kakiaghombela, “Musa kakityeka laghilo alyo lya kya unonopo ghwa myoyo yenu
Peni kutandila ubhumbilo ghwa nnima, ‘Chapanga kakiabhumba mundu nnume na mundu nndala.’
‘Ndo nnume katanleka tate ghwake na ma ghwake naywo katalungana na nndala ghwake.
Abha abhili bhatabhegha mmmili ghumo.’ Hinu abho abhili ng'obhe ngati mmili ghumo.
Hinu, kyakakilungite Chapanga, anamundu kakotoo kupwilinganiha.”
Pakayingilite munyumba kati, ahundwa bhake bhakinkonya ya kya nhalo ghula.
Mwene kakiaghombela, “Ywakanleka nndala ghwake na kutola yungi, kangutenda utyahe.
Na nndala ywakanleka nnume ghwake na kakatolelwa na nnume yungi, kangutenda utyahe.”
Yesu kanguanonela bhana adokwa
Bhandu bhakinnyeghela Yesu bhana adokwa ngati kabhayabhike mabhoko ghake unani mwabhe, ahundwa bhake bhakialakalila.
Yesu pakabhonite naha kakikalala na kakiaghombela ahundwa bhake, “Mubhategheke bhana ahike kwa nenga, nkotoke kuakanikiha, kiyaha Ghubhutwa ghwa Chapanga ndo ghwa bhandu bha abheghite handa abha.”
Kulyaghila nunguaghombela, mundu ywoheli ywa nga kukingama Ghubhutwa ghwa Chapanga handa bhana adokwa kahone kuyingila amwo.
Ndo kakiatola bhala bhana mu mabhoko ghake kakiapakata, kakiayabhika mabhoko ngati abhanonele.
Mundu yunautopelo
Yesu pakabheghite mu kubhuka, mundu yumo kakintughila, kakitundamila mayughwa mu ulongolo ghwake na kakinkonya, “Nhunda ghwa maha, ndende niki nighuhale ubhumi ghwa masiku ghoha ghwa nga uhiko?”
Yesu kakinnyanga, “Kiyaha niki ghungungema ghwa maha? Kahone mundu ghwa maha, ngati nga Chapanga ghweka chake.
Ghungughamanya malaghilo, ‘Kukoma kata, utyahe kata, kuyibha kata, unyimiho ghwa uhwangi kata, ukubhuhi kata, ghubhayikitile tate ghwako na ma ghwako.’”
Mwene kakinnyanga, “Nhunda, malaghilo agha hyoha nikighakamula tangu pa meghite nhongolo.”

Yesu kakinlolekeha na kakinpala, ndo kakinng'ombela “Ghupelelwa na kilibhi kimo ghughende ghukahemengane hyoha hiubheghite nahyo na ghubhapeghe ngalabha ahyo bhandu kapukwa, ghwabhegha na utopelo nnyoloho ku luhingu, mbole ghundughile.”
Yula mundu pakayihwite agho, kakukulika muno na kakibhuka kunu pakahyononeka, kiyaha kakibha na utopelo nnyoloho.
Yesu kakilolekeha mbande hyoha, kakiaghombela ahundwa bhake, “Kya bhuli yabhegha unonopo kwa bhana utopelo kuyingila mu Ghubhutwa ghwa Chapanga!”
Ahundwa bhake bhakikangacha muno kwa malagho agho, Yesu kakiaghombela kangi, “Bhana bhangu, kya bhuli yabhegha unonopo mundu yuna kuhyubhalila utopelo kuyingila mu Ghubhutwa ghwa Chapanga.
Yabhegha unonopo kwa yunautopelo kuyingiha mu Ghubhutwa ghwa Chapanga mbaha ya nnyama ngamiha kuhotola kuyingila mu lilanga lya sasia.”
Ahundwa bhake bhakikangacha muno bhakikonyana, “Ndo ghani aywo ywakahotola kulopoka?”
Yesu kakiahulutulila meho na kakiayanga, “Kwa anamundu ali kahone, peni kwa Chapanga ng'obhe; hyoha kwa Chapanga yahotolwa.”
Petili kunng'ombela, “Twenga tuhileka hyoha na kughutughila ghwenga!”

Yesu kakiaghombela, “Kulyaghila nunguaghombela mundu ywohele ywakalekite lubhagha lwake ebu nnongo ghwake ebu nhacha ebu maghwake ebu tate ghwake ebu bhana bhake ebu mighunda kwa kya nenga na kwa kya Nhalo ghwa Maha,

mwene katakamuhwa mala mbinda mabhoko kumi mu masiku agha, kitutubhi na nnongo ghwake na nhacha ghwake na Ma ghwake na tate ghwake na bhana bhake na mighunda papamo na himbamanda, mbole ndo ubhumi ghwa nga kupela munnima ghwalonda kuhika.
Peni bhandu ayoloho bhabheghite kuulongolo bhaabhegha ghwa kundahe na bha kundahe bhaabhegha bha ulongolo.”
Yesu kangulongela paundatu ya kya kuhwegha na uhyuko ghwake

Yesu na ahundwa bhake bhakibhegha munjila kughenda ku Yelusalemu na Yesu kakialongolela. Ahundwa bhakibha na bhwaghalihi, na bhandu bhaatughilite bhakimememwa bhakiyoghopa. Yesu kakiatola kangi bhala ahundwa mbinda mabhoko yimo na abhili kya ghweka na lula lumati na kakiaghombela ghala ghaalonda kunhikila.

Kakighomba, “Nnyihwe tunguhubhuka kughenda ku Yelusalemu, na akwo Mwana ghwa Mundu katakilukwa na katakamuhwa kwa hilongohi bha andundame na ahunda bha malaghilo. Bhene bhatantosa kiho, na kunkamuha kwa bhandu abheghite ng'obhe Akaayahudi.
Bhene bhatanhyula, bhatanhunila mata, bhatantuta minjupuchupu na kunkoma. Peni lisiku lya ndatu kaahyuka.”
Yakobu na Yohana bhangunnyupa Yesu
Ndo, Yakobu na Yohana, bhana bha Zebedayo, bhaking'endela Yesu na bhakinng'ombela, “Nhunda, tungupala ghututendele lyoheli lila litupala kukuyupa.”
Naywo Kakibhaghombela, “Hinu, mungupala nibhatendele nhalo ghani?”
Bhakinng'ombela, “paghutama mu kitebho kyako kya ukulu kya Ghubhutwa ghwako tungupala ghututamihe yumu mbande yako ya nnilo na yungi mu mbande ya nngiya.”
Yesu kakiaghombela, “Mungumanya ng'obhe kimukiyupa. Kulyaghila mahotola kulimbilia kimbamanda kya kya nenga na mabhegha kala kwa kiho kya nonda kuhwegha nenga.”
Bhakinnyanga “Twahotola” Ndo Yesu kakiaghombela, “Nteko ghwa nlonda kuywegha nenga manywela na ubatiso ghwa kya nenga mabatisighwa,
Peni kutama mbande yangu ya nnilo ebu ya ngiya, aghu ndo nnando ghwa nenga ng'obhe kuapegha ngati aghu ndo ya bhala bhaabhikilitwe kala na Chapanga.”
Bhala ahundwa bhangi mbinda mabhoko yimo paayihwite nhalo agho bhakiyanda kubhayaghabhalila Yakobu na Yohana.
Yesu kakiakema ahundwa bhake papamu na kakiaghombela, “Mungumanya kukita atabhala bha bhandu bha milima yingi bhangubhatabhala bhandu kwa makakala, nabho akulu bhanguangwiliha bhandu bhabhe.
Peni kwa mwenga kata. Mbole yake ywoheli ywakapala kubhegha nkulu mumabhene ndo yinguntama kabheghe nndumitumi ghwenu.
Na mundu ywoheli ywakapala kubhegha kilongohi, yinguntama kakaatumikile bhangi.
Kiyaha hata Mwana ghwa Mundu kakihika kutendelwa lihengo ng'obhe, ngati kakihika kutenda lihengo na kuubhuha ubhumi ghwake ghubheghe ukombohi kwa bhandu ayoloho.”
Yesu kangunlamiha Balitimayo mundu ywanga kubhona

Ndo bhakihika Yeliko, pala Yesu pakabhukite mukitami na ahundwa bhake papamu na lumati lukulu lwa bhandu, ywangakubhona lihina lyake Balitimayu, mwana ghwa Timayu, kakitama mumbhwegha ya njila pakiyupa utangwo.
Balitimayu pakayihwite kukita ndo Yesu ghwa ku Nasaleti ywakabheghite mukupita, kakiyanda kukweha lilobhe pakaghomba, “Yesu, Mwana ghwa Daudi, ghumonele luhungu!”
Bhandu ayoloho bhakinlakalila na kung'ombela kanyamale, peni mwene kakighendelela kukweha lilobhe pakighomba, “Mwana ghwa Daudi ghunmonele luhungu!”
Yesu kakiyima na kulongela, “Munkeme” Ndo bhakinkema yula ywanga kubhona bhaking'ombela, “Ghulikunge mwoyo, ghuyime, kangughukema.”
Kakilitagha lipinda lyake, na kakihumba na kung'endela Yesu.
Yesu kakinkonya, “Ghungupala nukutendele niki?” Yula ywanga kubhona kakinnyanga, “Nhunda ghwangu mbala kubhona.”
Yesu kaking'ombela, “Ghughende, hyubhalilo yako yikulamiha.” Kamu yula ywanga kubhona kakilola, naywo kakintughila Yesu na kakighenda naywo papamu.
